messages:
raj: Heads-up — we need richer telemetry for runtime kernel picks. Right now logs just say `kernel_id:42`. We can't tell why the runtime chose a kernel (arch bias, seq-length bucket, kv cache state, mem pressure, autotune score). This makes postmortems and regressions painful.

elaine: Agreed. Suggest a compact schema we can emit as a single JSON log per pick: `pick_reason` (enum), `seq_bucket` (<=32,33-128,129+), `hw_affinity`, `kv_cache` (hit/miss), `perf_score`, `kernel_signature`, and `config_flags`. Also support sampling to limit volume.

tyler: Can we also attach `trace_id` and `kv_cache_hit` boolean? When KV cache hits we often route to KV-optimized kernels and that explains a lot of head/tail behavior.

sarah: +1. Also make sure fallback reasons are explicit: `fallback: mem_pressure|timeout|incompatible_quant`. That way we know whether a pick was primary or forced. Keep fields short — logs blow up fast.

raj: Minimal example we can standardize on for a single line log (the runtime will emit this as a compact JSON blob):

```
RUNTIME_KERNEL_PICK: {"kernel_id":"k5_int8_attn","pick_reason":"seq_bucket_latency_win","seq_bucket":"33-128","hw_affinity":"ampere","kv_cache":"hit","perf_score":"0.87","env_flags":["REDWOOD_KERNEL_DEBUG=1"],"trace_id":"{{trace_id}}"}
```

Make `pick_reason` a stable enum so alerts can query it.

perf-bot: autotune-run-82: noticed +5% p95 tail on x86-infer after switching default to `k5_int8_attn` for 129+ seqs. Correlates with batch_size=1 and `kv_cache: miss`. Logged run: https://go/repro/82 — flagging as likely kernel-mispick under certain seq/batch combos.

elaine: For sampling knobs, propose env vars: `REDWOOD_KERNEL_CHOICE_SAMP=0.05` for 5% sampling and `REDWOOD_KERNEL_FORCE_REASON=<reason>` to force a synthetic pick_reason for debugging. Also `REDWOOD_KERNEL_DEBUG=1` to emit full fields.

tyler: Implementation notes: logger must be very cheap. Plan: per-worker ringbuffer (lock-free) + background flusher to telemetry. Expose compact reason codes (1..N) at wire-level; telemetry pipeline will map to enums. Keep JSON field order stable to help our parsers.

sarah: Ops asks: send to stdout for dev, and to telemetry pipeline with `schema=v1` tag. Also add a replayer tool that can read historical logs and extract `pick_reason` trends so we can detect when autotune changes traffic distribution.

raj: Action items:
- elaine: add schema PR for runtime logs (owner)
- tyler: implement ringbuffer + env knobs, ensure low allocation
- sarah: add pipeline mapping + replayer script for historical logs
- raj: schedule small autotune job with `debug=true` to exercise the new logs on a sample fleet

elaine: I'll open the PR today with schema.json example and a python parser snippet. Ping me if you want additional short codes.

tyler: I'll prototype ringbuffer tomorrow. Also thinking about packing `perf_score` as an int (0-100) to save bytes.

sarah: I'll wire perf-bot to tag autotune runs where `pick_reason` flips >10% of traffic, so we get automatic alerts.

raj: Cool — thanks everyone :rocket:
